motor.name: Kraken X44 — provisional WCP trapezoidal model

notes: User COM inertia assumed to be about an axis parallel to the pivot; lb interpreted as pound-mass.
WCP motor table is preliminary; not a verified current FOC model.
Rotor inertia is UNKNOWN; zero is an optimistic baseline, not a measured value.
Ideal transmission; unmeasured output friction and wiring resistance set to zero.
12 milliohm battery estimate originates from a 1 kHz impedance specification, not measured DC sag.
Ideal reversible battery accepts regeneration; 40 A regen cap is an assumed simulation bound, not a battery charge rating.
Ratios are mathematical candidates, not validated COTS combinations. No structural acceleration limit is provided.
